ns2:course.label: Soc Sc Research in LIS
ns2:course.description: Introduces students to the fundamentals of doing social science research in LIS. Students will learn how to frame a research problem, choose an appropriate research method, apply it, and write up the research for presentation and publication.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC or MS:Lib & Inf Sci Online-UIUC.
